scope: Initial settings for US English, left-to-right page comics. Adapt proportions and restrictions to the work and user instructions.

horizontalThree.example: If used on p1, leave p2-p5 between uses; next use is p6 or later. Check every rolling 20-page window, including p2-p21, not only p1-p20.

hardRules.dominanceScope: For plans of at least 20 pages, five-panel pages must outnumber each other panel count.

recommended.exceptionNote: Adjust large panels, spreads, two-panel pages, and added time-passage panels for staging and count actual panels. Exact proportions are not required.

selectionWorkflow: Decide the emotional change and focal moment of the page.
Choose panel count according to adopted proportions; narrow templates by wide-panel placement and purpose. Do not choose uniformly from all templates.
Choose an outline different from adjacent pages and assign events/dialogue by numbered reading order, left to right and top to bottom.

Use templates as a rule. If existing shapes cannot convey the staging adequately, record the page, intent, and reason and use a custom layout. User-required or disabled-template instructions take precedence.
All-template plans can be validated as JSON. With custom pages, inspect per-page records and actual placement; do not invent IDs or renumber pages to force validation.

Before imagegen artwork generation, actually supply a numbered layout image and panel contents; default to whole-page generation. Custom layouts also need references. Record reasons for separate-panel generation when needed.
After generation, compare panel count, placement, reading order, content, and text. Remove explanatory numbers/guides. Follow environment-specific procedures for NovelAI and other tools.
Do not mechanically crop existing wide artwork and claim it was composed for a new panel layout.
